page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs, operating at a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance type does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It does not feature any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its balanced 1:4 CPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.m1.medium is designed for general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for applications such as mid-range web servers, development environments, and small-scale databases that require dedicated CPU allocation without the need for local NVMe storage or hardware acceleration.
